pieces.eyebrow: Three lines for when they push back

lines.text: Thank you, but I'd like to cancel today. Please confirm the end date.

lines.label: Call us
lines.text: I'd like to cancel. What do you need from me to finish it today?

lines.label: Chat only
lines.text: Please cancel it now and send me written confirmation.
